find: for (const { pane, nouns } of attribution.panes) if (nouns.some((noun) => lower.includes(noun))) return pane;
replace: for (const { pane, nouns } of [...attribution.panes].reverse()) if (nouns.some((noun) => lower.includes(noun))) return pane;
why: The noun table is ordered, and the account's corrections depend on that order: "controller" is checked before "selftest". Reversed, a name containing two nouns lands in the other pane and the committed corrections stop describing the data.
killedBy: hud closure analysis (issue #767) puts a name in the FIRST pane whose noun it contains, and a correction wins over nouns
